policy.engineAuthority: The deterministic StewardMD reasoning engine owns diagnosis, confidence, ICMR precedence, hospital policy, and culture-directed recommendations. MaiK (the LLM) is advisory only and never overrides engine output; retrieved knowledge grounds explanation, not decision-making.

notes: This manifest records PROVENANCE only — no copyrighted source text is stored in it or in the KB. Disease and treatment content is paraphrased into structured fields (pearls, red flags, investigations, regimens) with a source ref + page/section anchor.

Clinician-facing source labels never surface a proprietary textbook title as the answer's authority; the disease reference is shown as 'Standard internal-medicine reference' while guideline/formulary sources are named.
Exact drug doses are shown only where the StewardMD Drug Index / a cited protocol states them; otherwise MaiK refers to drugs by name/class and says to verify locally.

sources.name: Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 22e (2025)
sources.role: Primary DISEASE reference — paraphrased into structured pearls, pathophysiology, differentials/mimics, investigations, red flags, severity, prognosis. Not a treatment authority (lowest treatment tier).
sources.coverageNote: Grounds all 484 searchable diseases (141 diagnostic + 343 reference-only). ~23k paraphrased chunks.

sources.name: ICMR / NCDC / National programme guidelines (India)
sources.publisher: Indian Council of Medical Research; National Centre for Disease Control; NTEP
sources.role: HIGHEST-precedence treatment source for the Indian context — empiric regimens, national AMR guidance, TB/typhoid/rickettsial/malaria protocols.
examples: Indian National Treatment Guidelines for Antimicrobial Use
NCDC India Guidelines for Rickettsial Diseases

sources.name: International society / specialty guidelines
sources.publisher: IDSA, IDSA/ATS, AASLD, ACC/AHA/ESC, KDIGO, GOLD, GINA, NCCN, IWGDF, BTS, AUA, SHEA, Baveno, ACR/EULAR and similar
sources.role: Middle-tier treatment source — condition-specific management protocols and severity/eligibility criteria, paraphrased.
sources.coverageNote: Cited across 42/51 infective syndromes and select non-infective conditions.
examples: IDSA Skin and Soft Tissue Infection Guidelines

sources.name: World Health Organization guidelines
sources.role: Global treatment guidance for tropical/communicable disease, paraphrased.

sources.name: Validated clinical criteria / severity scores
sources.role: Severity stratification and decision criteria, paraphrased/computed.

sources.name: StewardMD Drug Index
sources.role: Drug compositions, dose / route / frequency / duration, and coverage — the source of dosing shown in regimens.
sources.coverageNote: Backs the drug regimens on 43 diseases (42 infective syndromes + 1 non-infective).

sources.name: Local hospital / ICU antibiogram overlay
sources.role: Optional site-specific antibiogram / policy overlay. Surfaced SEPARATELY and never silently replaces the default recommendation.
sources.coverageNote: Present only where a site has configured a policy overlay.

guidelineDocuments.sourceTitle: National Guidelines for Management of Drug-Resistant TB
guidelineDocuments.applicability: DR-TB regimen selection, DST-driven logic, eligibility, dosing, monitoring, special situations, QT/hepatotoxicity/neuropathy management (India-facing, highest precedence).
guidelineDocuments.evidenceNotes: Paraphrased only; no verbatim text stored. Covers BPaLM, 9-11mo shorter oral, 18-20mo longer oral, H mono/poly-resistant, special populations, adverse-event annexures.
guidelineDocuments.clinicianFacingLabel: National Guidelines for Management of Drug-Resistant TB (NTEP, Nov 2024)

guidelineDocuments.sourceTitle: WHO consolidated guidelines / operational handbook on tuberculosis
guidelineDocuments.applicability: International comparative/reference guidance on TB treatment and DR-TB regimens; used as reference where NTEP is silent, never as the default over NTEP for India.
guidelineDocuments.evidenceNotes: Paraphrased only. Comparative/reference tier below NTEP for India-facing recommendations.

guidelineDocuments.sourceTitle: National Guidelines on Airborne Infection Control
guidelineDocuments.applicability: Airborne infection control (out of scope for treatment-regimen selection; referenced for isolation/AIC context only).
guidelineDocuments.evidenceNotes: Referenced for infection-control context; not a treatment-regimen source.
guidelineDocuments.clinicianFacingLabel: National Guidelines on Airborne Infection Control (2026)
